name: Krimml Waterfalls trail
why: Up a zigzag path beside the highest waterfalls of Austria, 380 m in three steps, with viewpoints right in the spray.
book: Small ticket at the bottom (May to October). Bus from Zell am See.
water: Huts and kiosks on the way.
dangers: Wet, slippery steps near the falls.

points.name: Krimml
points.note: The village at the foot of the falls.

points.name: Upper Krimml Falls
points.note: The upper fall in the forest above the valley.
